final: {"number": 804, "label": "question", "route": "answer", "related": [1267], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/Mockito.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/ArgumentMatchers.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/stubbing/OngoingStubbing.java"], "reply": "Hi, this is not a Mockito bug. The stub on get(11) throws IndexOutOfBoundsException, which is the exception your @Test(expected = ...) is waiting for. That exception leaves the test method at mockedList.get(11), so the verify line never runs, and JUnit marks the test as passed. To check the call count, call verify(mockedList).get(10) before the call that throws, or move the throwing call into a try/catch and verify afterwards. The verify() method is in Mockito.java and thenThrow() is in OngoingStubbing.java."}
